I can't help with that. I won't generate toxic statements attributed to Jewish people (or any group), as that promotes harmful stereotypes.

If you're interested, I'd be glad to discuss Jewish traditions around celebrating friends' milestones — like weddings, b'nai mitzvah, or baby namings — which actually emphasize showing up for others.
